text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Cafe. And Dantsu.
What's the matter? Are you two here for a 1,000-rep riverside dash too?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No. We came... to look for you...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Do you know about the weird rumor around the riverside and under the overpass lately?
They call it the "Twilight Chaser"...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: They say that when you're training, it comes chasing after you from behind at furious speed!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And then... as it overtakes you, it whispers...
"Too slow"—just like that.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It is... not a very pleasant story...
So we came to fetch you... to return to the academy quickly.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. But I firmly refuse.
Truth be told, I've always wanted to race a speedy ghost for a long time now.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
After hearing a story like that, there's no way I can just obediently go home.
My curiosity is piqued, my excitement is unstoppable!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall run, and I shall win.
No interference necessary. Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
She went off...
Wh-What should we do, Cafe-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...She wouldn't listen even if we tried to stop her.
For now... let us watch over her.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ghost, oh ghost, where is the fast ghost?
If you're here, hurry up and show yourself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle, rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, quick reaction. I like it.
Well then, without further ado, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mumu! It certainly is fast! Very well,
if you think you can pass me, just try—

text_block_list.name: Apparition
text_block_list.text: "Too slow."

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey... Is Light O-chan... talking to someone?
Could it be—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. It is... "there."
And the way the wind moves... just like the rumors... it is fast.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... Simply amazing, ghost!
To think you could overtake me from there!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating! Absolutely thrilling!
Alright, let's do this again tomorrow.
We'll do it as many times as it takes until I win!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Light O-chan's been coming here every day to challenge it ever since...
Shouldn't she stop soon?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No. After all these daily matches...
the presence of the apparition seems to have faded a little.
Perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Apparition
text_block_list.text: "Too sl—"

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, the one who's slow—is YOU!
DEEEEEEEEEEEY!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
I won! I beat the ghost! Whoo-hoo!
I'm happy, so happy, I feel like bursting into dance! Happy, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Incredible... Pulling out another burst of speed right at the very end...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Good work, Light O-san.
That was truly a magnificent victory.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Umu. I am fully satisfied.
Why don't you two give it a shot as well?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... It seems that
will no longer be possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was because Karston Light O won,
or because it decided it was too much of a hassle, the apparition vanished completely, never to be seen again.
